title: Const modeled outside VariableDeclaration
resolution: ConstantDeclaration now derives from VariableDeclaration so the spec taxonomy holds and consumers can match on `is VariableDeclaration` for both kinds.

title: ImplicitDeclaration lacks Type signature
resolution: Added internal-set Type and TypeSuffix fields on ImplicitDeclaration. null = Variant per the parser-AST convention; #9 inference can write through.

title: Case-insensitive comparison only documented
resolution: Added Declaration.NameComparer = StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase so scope-construction (#7-S2) and reference-resolution (#8) have a single canonical comparer.

title: SyntheticDeclarationProvenance is speculative
resolution: Removed. Lean-by-default; later sessions can re-introduce when first needed.
